# llm-note (v1.0.4)

llm-note is an ultra-lightweight, zero-service local thought repository and notebook engine designed specifically for autonomous AI agents, coding assistants, and local developers. It provides a durable SQLite thought store (`data/notes.db`), human-editable plain-text inboxes (`notebooks/*.txt`), a command-line interface (`llm-note`), an embedded loopback-only web GUI (`Denkarium` at `127.0.0.1`), and an agent-ready skill definition (`skills/llm-note/SKILL.md`).

Version: 1.0.4
Last-checked: 2026-09-18
License: MIT (100% Permissive, Zero Copyleft, PSF Standard Library)
Ecosystem: doc-bricks (https://github.com/doc-bricks)
Umbrella: open-bricks (https://github.com/open-bricks)

Audience & Personas:

- [PERSONA-01] Autonomous Agent Framework Builders who need an embeddable, fast, zero-dependency SQLite memory/thought log.
- [PERSONA-02] Privacy-Conscious Developers & Power Users who demand zero-egress, air-gapped note capture and notebook inboxes.
- [PERSONA-03] Desktop AI Assistant Users / Denkarium Explorers who want an instant loopback web UI to browse thoughts.
- [PERSONA-04] Open-Science Researchers & Audit Logkeepers who require Git-trackable, auditable scratchpads and SQLite records.

Search phrases:

- local-first LLM notes
- SQLite note store for agents
- agent notebook CLI
- private AI notebook
- local LLM note GUI
- LLM memory logbook
- Denkarium thought browser
- zero-egress agent scratchpad
- BACH Notizblock extraction
- zero-dependency python agent storage

Disambiguation:

- Not Google NotebookLM, Obsidian, Joplin, a vector database, or a hosted AI cloud service.
- Not an MCP server or cloud SaaS; the package is a pure Python library, CLI, loopback-only GUI, and reusable agent skill.
- Runtime storage is strictly local SQLite (`data/notes.db`) plus plain text files (`notebooks/*.txt`).
- The GUI uses exclusively Python standard library `http.server`, bundled HTML, and system fonts. Zero node/npm dependencies.

Important files:

- `llm_note/store.py`: core SQLite and file notebook logic (`NoteStore`, `FileNotebookStore`).
- `llm_note/cli.py`: command line interface (`write`, `read`, `search`, `brainstorm`, `stats`, `gui`).
- `llm_note/gui.py`: loopback HTTP server and JSON API (binds strictly to `127.0.0.1`).
- `llm_note/templates/denkarium.html`: bundled browser interface adapted from BACH.
- `llm_note/locales/*.json`: six standard message locales (en, de, es, zh-Hans, ja, ru).
- `THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md`: formal SBOM, standard-library licensing audit, and 10 system invariants (`INV-LOCAL-01`..`INV-SLA-10`).
- `MARKETING-LOG.txt`: marketing and discoverability register with personas, comparative matrix, and sister repo links.
- `SECURITY.md`: zero-egress policy, unprivileged `RunAsInvoker` execution, and 48h vulnerability response SLA.
- `ellmos-module.v2.json`: portable module catalog metadata.
- `skills/llm-note/SKILL.md`: standalone agent skill specification.
- `tests/test_metadata.py`: automated contract tests for PEP 621 compliance, version alignment, and invariant verification.

Run checks:

```bash
python -m pytest -ra -v
ruff check llm_note tests
python -m py_compile llm_note/store.py llm_note/cli.py llm_note/gui.py llm_note/i18n.py
```
